visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a young man wearing a black shirt and a black surgical mask, sitting in a room with traditional wooden-framed windows. He looks slightly to the side while talking, his posture relaxed. The background shows a dimly lit interior with soft shadows on the walls. (2) A woman with black hair and bangs, wearing a white sleeveless top, is shown in a close-up shot holding a small white cup. Her eyes are wide, and her mouth is open in a shocked expression, illuminated by a warm spotlight that makes her stand out from the dark background. (3) The camera shifts to an outdoor urban scene during the day. The woman stands in front of a dark green, two-story traditional wooden building located on a street corner. She gestures enthusiastically toward the structure while cars and motorbikes are visible in the background under bright natural daylight. (4) Inside the building, the focus shifts to various fabrics, a brown fedora hat on a mannequin, and a grey curtain with white lettering. The lighting is warm and bright, emphasizing the textures of the textiles. (5) The sequence transitions to food preparation; a metal scoop digs into green matcha powder, and a torch is used to char round rice dumplings on skewers. A close-up shows black sesame paste being piped onto the dumplings. (6) The woman is seen eating a piece of dango, chewing with a surprised and happy expression. She later sits with the man in the black shirt, discussing a row of wooden hooks on a white wall. The video concludes with shots of the shop's exterior and historical photographs framed on the wall.
